**Coaching note:**

Your knight on e5 was attacked twice and undefended—it had to move or be captured. Instead of retreating passively, **give check first** with Nd3+! This forces White's king to move. Then Nxb2 wins a pawn cleanly. The key: when your piece is attacked, look for forcing moves (especially checks) before retreating. A check gives you the tempo to attack something else.
